status.nb: 91 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 18 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Islamabad, Peshawar og Kabul.

summary.en: Houthi forces struck the Saudi Aramco building in Riyadh, prompting Pakistan to demand an immediate halt to all Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia. In Northwest Pakistan a police officer was killed in a terror attack, while the Baloch Army killed seven men it labelled Pakistani agents, including two minors, in Balochistan. The UN warned that 700 healthcare facilities are expected to close in Afghanistan, and Punjab officials linked regional smog to cross-border Diwali fireworks from India. The conflict still accounts for 1,794 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Houthi-styrkene angrep Saudi Aramco-bygningen i Riyadh, og Pakistan krevde umiddelbar stopp på alle houthi-angrep mot Saudi-Arabia. I Nordvest-Pakistan ble en politimann drept i et terrorangrep, mens Baloch-hæren drepte syv menn den kalte pakistanske agenter, inkludert to mindreårige, i Balochistan. FN advarte om at 700 helseinstitusjoner forventes å stenge i Afghanistan, og Punjab-myndighetene knyttet regional smog til Diwali-fyrverkeri fra India over grensen. Konflikten står fortsatt for 1 794 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
